dublin_core.dcvalue: The Polish Drama Corpus (PolDraCor) contains 50 Polish-language plays from 1772–1939 encoded in TEI XML. The corpus was prepared by the Historical Pragmalinguistic Team at the University of Silesia in Katowice, with technical support from CLARIN-PL. This description was reconstructed from the project repository; the original DSpace description was unavailable.
License verification pending: the archived DSpace listing showed Creative Commons attribution, whereas the source repository declares CC0 1.0. The original deposit license has not been recovered.
